rows.grounds: numeral indicating the eight supernatural powers
compound with internal sandhi: siddhi-saṃprāptiḥ (attainment of powers) + mūla-kaulam (root Kaula doctrine)

items.question: What constitutes the root Kaula teaching addressed to the fair-faced goddess?
premises: The eight supernatural powers are named as a key attainment.
The attainment of these powers is identified with the root Kaula.
This identification is declared directly to the fair-faced goddess.
items.inference: The attainment of the eight supernatural powers is equated with the essence of the root Kaula teaching.
uncertainties: The exact internal grammatical relations within the fused compound siddhisaṃprāptirmūlakaulaṃ are inferred from sandhi and context.
items.plain_english: And the attainment of the eight siddhis is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
